##  Create polygon outlines for dioceses

```{r setup}
#| echo: false

library(sf)
library(tigris)

GoogleCRS <- 4326

path <- "/home/ajackson/Dropbox/Rprojects/Eco_regions/Data/"

####   counties in Central Gulf Coast diocese

CGC_Florida <- c("Escambia", "Santa Rosa", "Okaloosa", "Walton", "Holmes", "Washington", "Bay", "Jackson", "Calhoun", "Gulf")
#   just a sliver of Franklin
Sliver <- c("-85.2427327 29.6891527", "-85.1651418 29.7043624", "-85.1187932 29.71629", "-85.0978505 29.7183772", "-85.0724446 29.7186754", "-85.0508153 29.7147992", "-85.0405156 29.7130101", "-85.0367391 29.7088355", "-85.0326192 29.7085373", "-85.0254094 29.7124137", "-85.0140798 29.7142028", "-85.0024068 29.7136065", "-84.9876439 29.7171846", "-84.9818074 29.7213589", "-84.9763143 29.7249367", "-84.9842107 29.7311976", "-84.9934804 29.7395448", "-85.0000035 29.7449105", "-85.0072133 29.7475933", "-85.0130498 29.7541508", "-85.0199163 29.7598138", "-85.027126 29.7651784", "-85.0374257 29.7657745", "-85.0425756 29.7702448", "-85.0477254 29.7759068", "-85.0521886 29.7800787", "-85.0590551 29.7854422", "-85.0655782 29.78723", "-85.0703847 29.7821645", "-85.0703847 29.7768008", "-85.0721013 29.7708408", "-85.0789678 29.7681587", "-85.0885808 29.7717348", "-85.0995671 29.7735229", "-85.1091802 29.7762048", "-85.2427327 29.6891527") 

Sliver <- 
  tibble(raw=trimws(Sliver)) |>
  mutate(raw = trimws(raw)) |>
  separate_wider_delim(raw, delim = " ", names = c("Long", "Lat")) |>
  mutate(across(c(Long, Lat), as.numeric)) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = GoogleCRS) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_combine(geometry)) |>
  st_cast("POLYGON")
```

##    define a function for processing the counties

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

Erase_counties <- function(selected_counties) {
  foo <- st_geometry(selected_counties) |>
  st_buffer(0.0003) |> # Adjust distance to match your CRS units (e.g., meters vs. degrees)
  st_union() |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |> # Drops any stray lines/points if present
  st_cast("POLYGON")
  
  foo
}

```
##  Process the data from shape files

- read in the county map for the whole state
- select out only the needed counties
- dissolve the lines between counties

### Diocese of the Central Gulf Coast

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

###################################################
#   Diocese of the Central Gulf Coast
###################################################

#     Read shape file
counties_sf <- st_read(paste0(path, "Florida_Counties_1%3A24000/Florida_Counties_1%3A24000.shp"))
#     Transform to Google CRS geographic coordinates
counties_sf <- st_transform(counties_sf, crs = GoogleCRS)
#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties <- counties_sf %>%
  filter(COUNTY %in% CGC_Florida)

plot(selected_counties)
plot(Sliver)
Slivera <- st_difference(Sliver, st_union(selected_counties))
plot(Slivera)
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=Sliver, color="navy") +
  geom_sf(data=Slivera, color="red") 
New_Florida <- bind_rows(selected_counties, Slivera) 
plot(New_Florida)

#   Now do Alabama

#     Read shape file
counties_sfa <- st_read(paste0(path, "Alabama_Counties-shp/"))
#     Transform to Google CRS geographic coordinates
counties_sfa <- st_transform(counties_sfa, crs = GoogleCRS)
#     Select out the desired counties
Alabama <- counties_sfa %>%
  filter(NAME %in% CGC_Alabama) |> 
  rename(COUNTY=NAME)

plot(Alabama)

#   Combine them all

# CGC <- st_union(st_geometry(New_Florida), st_geometry(Alabama)) |>
  # st_sf()

CGC <- c(st_geometry(New_Florida), st_geometry(Alabama)) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_buffer(0.0003) |> # Adjust distance to match your CRS units (e.g., meters vs. degrees)
  st_union() |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |> # Drops any stray lines/points if present
  st_cast("POLYGON")

# CGC <- bind_rows(
#   select(New_Florida, geometry),
#   select(Alabama, geometry)
# ) |>
#   summarise()

plot(CGC)

saveRDS(CGC, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Central_Gulf_Coast_outline.rds"))
```

##    Process data from census files

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Cache downloaded shapefiles locally so repeated runs don't re-download
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)


###################################################
#   Diocese of Kansas
###################################################

# Download Kansas counties as an sf object (1:500k cartographic boundary)
# accepts state name, abbreviation, or FIPS
ks_counties <- counties(state = "KS", cb = TRUE)|>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS) 

plot(ks_counties)

#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties <- ks_counties %>%
  filter(NAME %in% Kansas)

plot(selected_counties)

KS <- Erase_counties(selected_counties)

plot(KS)

saveRDS(KS, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Kansas_outline.rds"))

###################################################
#   Diocese of Western Kansas
###################################################

#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties <- ks_counties %>%
  filter(NAME %in% WKansas)

plot(selected_counties)

WKS <- Erase_counties(selected_counties)

plot(WKS)

saveRDS(WKS, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Western_Kansas_outline.rds"))

###################################################
#   Diocese of Northwest Texas
###################################################

# Download Texas counties as an sf object (1:500k cartographic boundary)
# accepts state name, abbreviation, or FIPS
tx_counties <- counties(state = "TX", cb = TRUE)|>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS) 

plot(tx_counties)

#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties <- tx_counties %>%
  filter(NAME %in% NWTexas)

plot(selected_counties)

NWTX <- Erase_counties(selected_counties)

plot(NWTX)

saveRDS(NWTX, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Northwest_Texas_outline.rds"))

###################################################
#   Diocese of Idaho 
###################################################

id_counties <- counties(state = "ID", cb = TRUE)|>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)
plot(id_counties)
wy_counties <- counties(state = "WY", cb = TRUE)|>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)
plot(wy_counties)

#   Need to create a polygon for the part of Idaho county south of the Salmon river

# library(lwgeom)

# 1. Download Idaho County boundary
idaho_county <- counties(state = "ID", cb = FALSE, year = 2023) %>%
  filter(NAME == "Idaho")  

# 2. Download linear water features for Idaho County and filter for the Salmon River
# Note: Use st_union() and st_line_merge() so the river acts as a continuous blade
salmon_river <- linear_water(state = "ID", county = "Idaho", year = 2023) %>%
  filter(FULLNAME == "Salmon Riv") %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_line_merge()  

# Ensure both layers share the exact same CRS
salmon_river <- st_transform(salmon_river, st_crs(idaho_county))

# 3. Split the county polygon using the river line
# Note: Disable S2 spherical geometry temporarily so planar splitting works cleanly
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
split_geoms <- lwgeom::st_split(idaho_county, salmon_river) %>%
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON")
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

# 4. Filter to keep only the polygon(s) south of the river
# A reliable method is selecting the split piece with the lowest centroid latitude,
# or keeping pieces with centroids south of ~45.42° N (Riggins / Salmon River bend).
idaho_county_south <- split_geoms %>%
  mutate(
    area = as.numeric(st_area(.)),
    centroid_lat = st_coordinates(st_centroid(.))[, 2]
  ) %>%
  # Filter out tiny river-island slivers and keep the main southern portion
  filter(area > 1e7, centroid_lat < 45.45) |> 
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)

# 5. Plot to verify the result
plot(st_geometry(idaho_county), border = "gray70", lty = 2, main = "Idaho County (South of Salmon River)")
plot(st_geometry(idaho_county_south), col = "lightblue", border = "navy", add = TRUE)
plot(st_geometry(salmon_river), col = "blue", lwd = 2, add = TRUE)

#   Extract needed counties from Idaho and sliver from Wyoming, and then combine all.

#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties_id <- id_counties %>%
  filter(NAME %in% Idaho_ID)

plot(selected_counties_id)

alta_wy <- places(state = "WY", cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(GEOID == "5601985") |>
  st_transform(4326)

plot(alta_wy)

combined <- c(st_geometry(alta_wy), 
               st_geometry(selected_counties_id),
               st_geometry(idaho_county_south))

plot(combined)

Idaho <- Erase_counties(combined)

plot(Idaho)

saveRDS(Idaho, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Idaho_outline.rds"))

###################################################
#   Dioceses of Nebraska, North & South Dakota, Iowa, Montana, Colorado 
###################################################

Nebraska <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "NE") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)

plot(Nebraska)

saveRDS(Nebraska, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Nebraska_outline.rds"))

NDakota <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "ND") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)

plot(NDakota)

saveRDS(NDakota, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_NDakota_outline.rds"))

SDakota <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "SD") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)

plot(SDakota)

saveRDS(SDakota, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_SDakota_outline.rds"))

Iowa <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "IA") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)

plot(Iowa)

saveRDS(Iowa, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Iowa_outline.rds"))

Montana <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "MT") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)

plot(Montana)

saveRDS(Montana, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Montana_outline.rds"))

Colorado <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "CO") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS)

plot(Colorado)

saveRDS(Colorado, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Colorado_outline.rds"))

###################################################
#   Diocese of Wyoming
###################################################

#   All of Wyoming, but subtract alta_wy

Wyoming <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "WY") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS) |>
  st_make_valid()

# Subtract Alta's polygon from Wyoming
wy_minus_alta <- st_difference(
  Wyoming,
  st_union(st_geometry(alta_wy))
)

plot(Wyoming)
plot(wy_minus_alta)

saveRDS(wy_minus_alta, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Wyoming_outline.rds"))

###################################################
#   Diocese of Navaho Land
###################################################

# 1. Pull Navajo Nation geometry and transform to EPSG:4326
navajo_raw <- native_areas(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(grepl("Navajo", NAME, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS) |>
  st_make_valid()

plot(navajo_raw)

# Combine into a single geometry if split across rows, then explode into individual POLYGONs
navajo_parts <- navajo_raw |>
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry)) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_cast("POLYGON")

plot(navajo_parts)

# 2. Keep only the largest polygon (preserves its interior ring / hole while dropping small satellites)
navajo_main <- navajo_parts |>
  mutate(area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) |>
  slice_max(area_m2, n = 1) |>
  select(-area_m2)

plot(navajo_main)

# Inspect hole areas (in square meters) on the main polygon
poly_rings <- navajo_main$geometry[[1]]
if (length(poly_rings) > 1) {
  hole_areas <- sapply(poly_rings[-1], function(ring) {
    as.numeric(st_area(st_polygon(list(ring))))
  })
  print(sort(hole_areas, decreasing = TRUE))

  # Keep outer ring + only holes larger than, say, 100 sq km (1e8 m^2)
  keep_holes <- poly_rings[-1][hole_areas > 1e-1]
  navajo_main$geometry <- st_sfc(
    st_polygon(c(list(poly_rings[[1]]), keep_holes)),
    crs = GoogleCRS
  )
}

plot(navajo_main)

saveRDS(navajo_main, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Navajo_Land_outline.rds"))

###################################################
#   Diocese of The Rio Grande
###################################################

#   New Mexico minus Navaho Land, plus a bit of Texas

NM_counties <-  counties(state = "NM", cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "NM") |>
  st_transform(GoogleCRS) |>
  st_make_valid()

#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties <- NM_counties %>%
  filter(NAME %in% RioGrande_NM)

plot(selected_counties)

# Subtract Navaho Land's polygon from Wyoming

selected_counties <- st_difference(
  selected_counties,
  st_union(st_geometry(navajo_main))
)

plot(selected_counties)

RG_NM <- Erase_counties(selected_counties)

plot(RG_NM)

#   Texas counties for diocese

#     Select out the desired counties
selected_counties <- tx_counties %>%
  filter(NAME %in% RioGrande_TX)

plot(selected_counties)

RioGTX <- Erase_counties(selected_counties)

plot(RioGTX)

#   Combine and save

combined <- c(st_geometry(RioGTX), 
               st_geometry(RG_NM)) |> 
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 0, preserveTopology = TRUE) |>
  st_make_valid()

plot(combined)

Rio_Grande <- Erase_counties(combined)

plot(Rio_Grande)

saveRDS(Rio_Grande, paste0(savepath, "Diocese_Rio_Grande_outline.rds"))





```
